mainEntity.name: How long does a typical project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most demo-sized builds take 2–6 weeks from brief to launch, depending on scope. You get a timeline with milestones before work starts.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with startups or only large companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. Most demo projects are early-stage startups that need a fast, polished first version.

mainEntity.name: What does your design process look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Research first, then wireframes, then high-fidelity UI. You approve each stage before development begins.

mainEntity.name: Can you maintain the app after launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — bug fixes, performance tweaks and small feature updates are part of the testing & maintenance service.
Send a message through the contact page with your idea. This demo form does not send anything yet — it shows the flow.
